description: 15 frozen real-world upstream changes verified from official release/spec/repository evidence or clearly identified upstream issues as of 2026-09-09. Labels are project-state-aware, including installed-version and direct-vs-transitive hard negatives.

cases.rationale: Direct MCP SDK upgrade from installed 2.1.1 to 2.2.0 changes transport/OAuth/schema behavior used by SignalHarness.
Current MCP v2 resource allowlist path-normalization issue crosses a permission boundary and affects the installed major line.
MCP protocol session/initialization semantics changed materially and SignalHarness exposes Streamable HTTP MCP.
Typer is direct and newer, but the documented breaking change is metavar presentation rather than a demonstrated runtime blocker.
Pydantic patch is newer than the installed direct dependency but contains maintenance fixes without a demonstrated SignalHarness break.
SignalHarness already resolves FastAPI 0.141.1, so the observed 0.141.1 release is not a pending project change.
FastAPI 0.140.13 is older than the installed 0.141.1 and its SSE fix is already superseded for this project.
SignalHarness already resolves Uvicorn 0.52.4 and the fix targets WebSocket handshakes rather than the primary SSE path.
SignalHarness already resolves Rich 15.0.0 and requires Python 3.10+, so the dropped Python 3.8 support is already satisfied.
LangGraph is monitored ecosystem context; checkpoint/trace-policy changes are useful competitive architecture evidence but not direct project breakage.
OpenAI Agents SDK testing/provider-neutral changes are relevant ecosystem evidence but the package is not a direct dependency.
OpenAI Agents SDK changes model/MCP integration but is not a direct SignalHarness dependency; it must not be escalated as an MCP package upgrade.
AutoGen maintenance mode is a material tracked-competitor lifecycle change, useful strategically but not an immediate project failure.
Current MCP 2.x structuredContent/outputSchema mismatch can affect SignalHarness structured MCP tool payload compatibility.
The upstream issue explicitly targets a v1 backport and states the bug is fixed on 2.x; SignalHarness resolves mcp 2.1.1.
